difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the existence and universal property of a closed immersion X' into a locally Noetherian formal algebraic space X over a complete DVR, representing the locus flat over A (source lines 5751-5829, label lemma-flat-locus). The solver must quotient torsion affinely, glue the local flat parts over the etale presentation via an etale equivalence relation, descend representability and monomorphism properties along etale covers, and finally establish the global universal property; the sheaf-level gluing with the monomorphism identification of the relation is a substantive argument. Allowed background: the presentation formalism and the cited spaces, bootstrap and formal spaces lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
